content: Lagaw thoerpumay woer

Nuydh Nowa nanga butaw aymay muwasidhin, Awgadh wara thonara nubepa mulaydhin kedha, ‘Ngi a nginu ipi kazil a kaziw ipil sew butanu pathemiw. Ngay ngulayg kedha, matha ngi wadhe thulu mabayg nubi apaw goewanu.

Wa, uruyl lak kedha, ngi mina ngulayg kedha wara tetel uruyl mina poeybayzi zapul ngayapa. Ngidh kedha uruyngu ngibiya kalmel kusumoene seben garkazil a seben yoepkazil. Kasa uruyl nanga, ngidh ukasar ukasar kusumoene, garkaz a yoepkaz.

‘Wara boethal uruyl lak kedha, thana setha ngaya nanga mina poeybayzi zapul ngayapa, ngidh kedha boethal uruyngu ngibiya kalmel kusumoene, seben garkazil a seben yoepkazil. Ngidh bangal kedha aymoene thanamulpa igil poelaypa, kurusipa bangal thana yaynanob kazil mamayine thabi apaw goewanu.
Seben goeygil waniz koezi, ngath bangal ari wayane, poti goeygilnga a poti kubiloelnga mura igilzapa umamathamaypa, mura ngaw oeymayzimayl.’
Nowa mina mura aymoedhin Awgadhaw ubilnga midh nanga
Wa, Nowa mina mura aymoedhin Awgadh nubepa midh na mulaydhin.
Lagaw thoerpumay woer nanga wayadhin, sethabi thonara Nowan wathal 600 mura.
Nuy a nungu ipi a nungu garkaz kazil, a thanamun ipil mura but wangaydhin, thanamulngu wara dudupoeyle.
A mura uruyngu yoepkaz a garkaz but wangaydhin Nowaniya, setha mi uruyl nanga Awgadhoepa poeybaypa balbayginga a wara uruyl thana mura wangaydhin Awgadh midh na mulaydhin.
Wa, Awgadh kulay mulaydhin wagel kay na za aymaydhin, seben goeygiw kaliya lagaw thoerpumay woer wayaydhin.

Wa, nuy Nowa senabi thonara 600 wathoelayg, thanamun wathaw a moelpalaw thonaral kedha ukasar moelpal nanga, numela goeyga sebentin, mura boeradharaw muy ngukil boeradharal yoelgamoeydhin a ariw nguki gimaz mulupa mina koeyma payoewdhaydhin.
Ari matha woeydheypu poti goeygilnga a poti kubiloelnga
A senabi ari matha woeydheypu poti goeygilnga a poti kubiloelnga.
Senawbi goeyginu nanga thana mura muynu nge butanu, Nowa, nungu ipi, nungu thoeri garkaz kazil Sem, Am, a Zapeth, a thanamun ipil,
thanamuniya kalmel mura uruyl, thubudh uruyl, bupaw uruyl, moegina uruyl, a koey uruyl, kasa mura boethal uruyl,
yoepkazil a garkazil mura yaynanob uruyngu but wangaydhin, thanamun mura yaynanob uruy igililnga danal poethaypa.
Wa, senawbi goeyginu nanga thana mura muynu nge Awgadh midh nanga mulaydhin. Kalanu nuydh Awgadhan koey butaw pasa gud thamudhoedhin.
Senabi ari mina gegeyadh gamu tharaydhin poti goeygilnga, woer malu asidhin, thanamun but pulaloedhin.
Woer malu asidhin, nuyn but adhanithudhin, nuy kasa bal thayar maluya.
Woer ngapa kadaypa, koey padal mura wardhamoeydhin,
na matha kadaypa woelmay woer, kurusipa na seben mita padaw guyangu kadaypa woerngu padoepa.
Mura igililmayl zapul umamayl, mura boethal uruyl, mura tetel uruyl, a mura amayl uruyl, a mura mabaygal.
Setha mura ngoenawoelaylmayl kasa umamayl.
Wa, nuydh Awgadhan kedha madhin, kasa mura idimoedhin, mabaygal, uruyl, a boethal uruyl. Igililmayl matha wanaydhin Nowa, nubiya ngaya nanga butanu muynu.
Woer matha gimanoeka tharal nanga 150 goeygilnga.
